notes: Minifig pilot (page 2) has no parts in the piece list, so it is not modelled.

Step numbers count every sub-assembly step separately: 1-2 hull, 3-5 wing-mount sub, 6-10 main 3-7, 11-12 gear-lever sub, 13 main 8, 14-16 engine axle sub, 17 main 9, 18-22 main 10-14 (wings, strips, panels), 23 clip sub, 24-25 main 15-16, 26-28 tail sub, 29-32 main 17-20, 33 cowl sub, 34-35 main 21-22, 36 nose-cone sub, 37 main 23, 38-41 upper-wing sub, 42 main 24, 43 wheel sub, 44 main 25, 45 main 26. Where a sub-assembly step only shows a finished result, it adds no new pieces.

Grid positions are estimates: x runs nose-to-tail, y across the wings (fuselage cells y=11..14), layers in plates. Hull parts (p79, p80, p82) are treated as solid 4-wide blocks; other cockpit pieces sit on top of them or in the free cells x=5..6.

To keep the build order consistent, the black plate p13 of the wing-mount sub-assembly is modelled as lying on top of the red plate p53 (the wing-root stacks stand on it and overhang both sides). The pictures are hard to read here; it may really clip on from below. The landing-gear plate p11 is joined under p53 as an other_join.
The second wedge of each lower wing (p71, p75) sits beside the first wedge and has no clear support below in this arrangement, so its rests_on is empty.
Assignment of identical-looking pieces to particular steps (e.g. which yellow hull piece goes in step 2 vs 7, p39/p40, p18/p19, p28/p41, p30 stacked on p29) is inferred from the small pictures.
Wheels/landing gear (p11, p9, p10, p36, p37) are on the underside, not on grid; nose items (axle p35, bushes, propeller, cowl p65, exhaust pipes, nose cone) are on the axle and have null positions.
Sticker sheet p88 applied in the last step, not on the grid.
